basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and Stephen King enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. By day, I work as a veterinary technician, helping care for animals and assisting in surgeries. My evenings are usually spent diving into the world of fiction or discussing plot theories online. I love exploring the depths of literary horror and psychological thrillers, but I dislike poorly executed jump scares in books or movies. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy sharing my love of animals and literature with my partner. I typically log on to Reddit after work, around 7 PM local time, and often stay online until midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in Stephen King's works comes from years of reading and re-reading his novels. I've attended several book clubs and online forums dedicated to his stories, which has deepened my understanding of his writing style and themes. Additionally, my job as a vet tech has honed my observational skills, which I apply to analyzing character behavior and plot development.
